reviews.text:
Dr. Maria is truly an exceptional veterinarian, and I cannot say enough wonderful things about her. She is a remarkable combination of professionalism, knowledge, compassion, and genuine integrity.
What makes Dr. Maria so special is her incredible love for animals. She treats every pet as if they were her own, with patience, tenderness, and sincere concern for their well-being. You can truly feel that her work comes from the heart.
She takes the time to listen, carefully evaluate each situation, explain everything in detail, and make sure you understand the diagnosis and treatment options. I always feel that my pet is in the hands of someone who genuinely cares and will always do what is best for the animal.
Her dedication, honesty, professionalism, and compassion are truly exceptional. I am incredibly grateful to have Dr. Maria as my pet’s veterinarian and would wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone looking for a veterinarian who combines outstanding medical care with genuine love and respect for animals.
Thank you, Dr. Maria, for everything you do and for treating our beloved pets with so much love and care. ❤️🐾
Excellent place. Very helpful staff.
Love the staff at this vet.  They are so kind and make every pet feel like thee greatest pet in the world.  I have recommended this place to several friends and they have all been happy.
Dr. Oliveira is the best!
Professional. Caring. Meticulous. Honest. Very happy with my first visit here and definitely found a new place to take my cat. Thank you!
Gentle with the pets and fair price

I have absolutely nothing but positive things to say about Dr. Oliveira and all of her staff members. You can tell how much they care about animals; but especially their patients. Our fur babies always feel safe and loved during their visits. We will definitely be forever patients!
Best vet in Miami! And a super caring staff to boot.

This place really cares.
Great place to take your pet.
This is great office. Doctors and stuff are very attentive to your pet's needs.

Took my rescue cat Lulu after I found her in the street, she was very ill and would faint. She made a full recovery into the beautiful and healthy adult cat as you can see in the pictures. Dr. O also took care of my two dogs Bella and Machi and was very understanding. She listened to my concerns and explained to me every step of the process of their care.

with the exception of one front desk employee , this is a very caring clinic...the doctor is extremely busy but kind and caring, her technicians are exceptionally knowledgeable and skilled,  The prices are very reasonable .. I do find that texts are not always responded to, direct call may be more predictable. You can tell how popular the doctor is by the number of people from all over Miami who bring their pets to this clinic and their loyalty shows!
The bank was amazing. Way over my expectations.

This clinic was recommended to me by a friend and I will recommend it to anyone who’ll listen!! They took great care of my cat, Gamut, who was picked up from the street. They knew exactly what to do with her when I brought her in and she’s doing great now! Gamut and I always felt extremely welcome by all the staff and I truly believe that Dr. Oliveira cares deeply for all her little patients.

Doctor María and her team are expert and dedicated animal health professionals. They deliver with competence and TLC. Further, Doctor María is NOT one of those revenue-driven vets that will push services to drive fees
Amazing place ❤️they were super nice with my Cat Luna and she is getting better
Have been coming here for 16 years and Dr. María has taken excellent care of all my dogs.
Very knowledgeable, fair and caring. Also very affordable. Highly recommend!
This place is absolutely wonderful and I am very grateful to Dr. Oliveira for how compassionate and professional she is with my pets.
Amazing pet clinic! They have helped all my pets throughout the years.
Hands down the best. Dr O is a phenomenal vet and human being. She cares and is so knowledgeable. Sure does so much to help animals. Her team is also amazing
Excellent service and very good professionals.

Five years ago, I arrived in the US with my 9-year-old Chihuahua. I decided I had to follow the rules of this country regarding dogs, choosing this clinic because it was easy to get to; I live very close by. Since then, my boy has been cared for there by the vet and her wonderful team. The best and most correct decision of my life. I trust the vet completely; her diagnoses have always been accurate, and the care is excellent—kind, professional, and thorough. I recommend it without hesitation! I don't trust anyone else but her and her team. Thank you for always being there. Blessings to the whole team. Jimmy and Mom are so grateful! 🤩🙏

The receptionist and doctor were so sweet with my dog and they do take walk-ins which is nice. My only downside to going here is that the clinic feels dirty, the table my dog was on wasn’t clean, neither was the floor. I understand that dogs are messy and shed, but I think it would have been more comforting to me if the exam table was wiped down.

They are an excellent clinic and their love for animals is something you don't find in every clinic. The doctor is very good, I highly recommend her 💯👍👌🫶🐈🐕. They treated my little cat 🐈🫶💯. He's a kitten rescued from the street, and the doctor treated him with such great love that her words were very comforting to me. My little cat 🐈🐈 has recovered incredibly well.
Molly says this place is purr-fect. The staff here have taken excellent care her and her brother Chino.
Dr.  Maria is the best!

I’ve been taking my cats to South Miami Animal Clinic for almost a year, ever since I adopted them, and I couldn’t be happier with the care they’ve received. Dr. Oliveira is absolutely wonderful—she’s kind, down-to-earth, knowledgeable, and highly competent. What I really appreciate is her sensible approach: she won’t push unnecessary tests or procedures, only recommending what’s truly needed for the health and well-being of your pet.

The staff is equally great—always accommodating when I’ve needed to bring a pet in on short notice. As someone who tends to worry, I find their reassurance and understanding incredibly comforting. Sylvia at the front desk deserves a special shoutout. She runs the office like a pro and treats every client with kindness and respect, no matter how busy things get.

Highly recommend this clinic for anyone seeking skilled, caring veterinary care for their pets!
Best and most caring vet in Miami!!!
Amazing care and compassion! This veterinary clinic goes above and beyond for pets and owners. Friendly staff, expert vets, and a welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommend!
Maria genuinely cares. We have been taking our cats to her for over 15 years
Excellent staff who are very friendly, pleasant, and cordial, and they love their work, which is the most important thing!
Best Vet in Miami
Best veterinary clinic in Miami
Amazing ! We love it here ❤️

I have been coming here for years. Absolutely exceptional staff. They cared for my late dog and helped him cross the rainbow bridge. They are the current vet for my current dog and we could not be happier, the service is always amazing.
